g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 5 schedule rows of docs-authority/nozzles/HDR_UPW.csv at tag, face and bore

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N1 DN25 inlet on -Y drawn at 17.6 mm (datum 10 clamped up for the branch bore); N2 DN15 outlet on +Y at its 37 mm datum; N3 DN25 outlet clamped down to 32.4 mm to keep the branch bore inside the cross-section
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: The UPW_TO_FAB edge (to the fab tank) carries no distinct schedule row - the N3 fab UPW branch serves the fab side; drawn verbatim, no nozzle invented (hold W12)
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N4 drain flush at the envelope bottom, N5 vent flush at the top
